plugins.name: drydock
plugins.description: Diagnose and fix Kubernetes and Docker problems: pod crash triage playbooks, Dockerfile optimization, Helm chart review, and Compose file review

skills.name: compose-review
skills.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "review my docker-compose file", "fix my compose setup", mentions docker compose services not starting in order, containers that can't reach each other, compose volumes, or env var handling in compose. Reviews and fixes Compose files for reliability and local-dev ergonomics.
headings: Startup ordering — the #1 source of flaky compose setups
skills.description_zh: 审查和修复Docker Compose可靠性与本地开发体验，处理服务启动顺序、容器互联、卷和环境变量。

skills.name: docker-debug
skills.description: This skill should be used when a container exits immediately, docker run fails, a port is already allocated, the user cannot connect to a published port, docker logs are empty, a bind mount hides files, permission is denied in the container, or they see "exec format error". Runs a structured, read-only-first diagnostic workflow with docker / docker compose.
headings: Step 2: Classify and follow the playbook
Cannot connect to a published port
skills.description_zh: 先只读诊断Docker容器退出、运行失败、端口占用、连接、空日志、挂载遮蔽、权限与架构格式问题。

skills.name: dockerfile-optimize
skills.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "optimize a Dockerfile", "make my image smaller", "speed up docker build", mentions slow builds, large image size, Docker layer caching, or asks to review/write a Dockerfile. Applies multi-stage builds, cache-friendly layer ordering, and security hardening.
headings: Good: source changes don't invalidate the dependency layer
skills.description_zh: 编写或优化Dockerfile，使用多阶段构建、适合缓存的层次及安全加固，提高构建速度并缩小镜像。

skills.name: helm-review
skills.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "review a Helm chart", "check my chart", mentions Helm templates, values.yaml design, chart versioning, or debugging "helm install/upgrade" failures. Reviews charts for correctness, upgrade safety, and production readiness.
skills.description_zh: 审查Helm模板、values、版本与安装升级失败，检查正确性、升级安全和生产准备。

skills.name: k8s-debug
skills.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "debug a pod", "why is my pod crashing", mentions "CrashLoopBackOff", "ImagePullBackOff", "OOMKilled", "pod pending", "pod not ready", or asks to troubleshoot any Kubernetes workload, Service, Ingress, or DNS problem. Runs a structured, read-only-first diagnostic workflow with kubectl.
headings: Step 2: Classify and follow the playbook
Running but not Ready / Service returns no endpoints
skills.description_zh: 通过kubectl先只读诊断Kubernetes崩溃、拉镜像、内存不足、等待或未就绪，以及Service、Ingress和DNS问题。
